title: Evidence Gate policy
description: Team rules: what READY means, high-risk paths, route order and the spot-check rate.

should_failures.description: What happens when a SHOULD criterion is not verified.

high_risk_paths.description: Glob patterns of code that always gets full human review.

ignore_paths.description: Glob patterns of changed files the Gate ignores.

routes.description: Checked top to bottom; the first match wins.

route.description: How much human review is still needed.

spot_check.description: QA re-checks a share of light-routed changes to measure the miss rate.

sample_rate.description: Share of light-review changes to re-check (0 to 1).

pause_light_route_if_miss_rate_above.description: Stop using the light route if the miss rate goes above this (0 to 1).
